name: fnp-qnn-chamber-formalizer
description: Synthia-gated FNP-QNN chamber formalization and local visual handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Formalize ten carrier variables for a Synthia-gated chamber.
interface.longDescription: Creates a reviewable ten-carrier proposal for the native QuaNThoR formalizer and FNP-QNN local Three.js chamber. It never imitates or bypasses Synthia admission.
